claims.value: Cola DLM is a hierarchical continuous latent-space diffusion language model combining a Text VAE with a block-causal Diffusion Transformer prior.
claims.evidence: Cola DLM is a hierarchical continuous latent-space diffusion language model. It combines a Text VAE with a block-causal Diffusion Transformer (DiT) prior
